posts.text: “Good morning. It’s Saturday.  This is the perfect day to do things that make you waggle or to get rested for future waggling. Also, I love you.”

This is just an observational  point. Trump could get the exact 60 Day Ceasefire of his dreams. And it could even be fully implemented. It would still be basically strategically meaningless. This talk about a “deal” and talk about a 60-day whatever, as if they’re remotely the same thing is stupid. Anyone who says “strategic triumph” or “strategic disaster” about a 60 day deal of any kind is leaping to conclusions, at best.
